messages:
jamie_sales: OrionHealth asking for a reserved commit + legal-approved fallback. Peak ~3200 RPS chat, mix ~65% short (~45 toks) / 35% long (~700 toks). Need AZ spread, preheat plan, and a simple degradation order.

ryan_se: Which model(s) are they planning? Also confirm session stickiness and KV usage.

taylor_ml: They plan 13B-distilled (4-bit) primary, 6B quantized fallback. Rough runtime perf: 13B ~0.9M tok/s per GPU, 6B ~1.6M tok/s. Avg toks/request ~0.65*45 + 0.35*700 = ~261 -> ~835k tok/s at 3200 RPS.

devin_eng: Sizing note: ideal GPUs ~0.93. Recommend conservative commit = 4 reserved GPUs across AZs, plus 2 burst vGPU credits. Autoscale policy: min_replicas=1/az, scale_up when util>75% for 30s, scale_down cooldown 5m. Preheat: 45m window with KV priming.

infra_bot: Sim run: 3200 RPS -> recommend reserve 4 + 2 burst, expected p95 gen latency ~240-320ms depending on batching and preheat.

kelly_security: For questionnaire paste-ready: "Dedicated supports customer-managed KMS (AWS/GCP/Azure), encryption in transit & at rest. Audit logs can be forwarded to customer SIEM with configurable retention. Network isolation via VPC peering and private subnets."

jamie_sales: Great. Actions: Devin/Taylor confirm perf doc & preheat runbook by EOD; Ryan to draft pricing compare (reserve4+burst2 vs reserve6); Kelly paste KMS snippet into questionnaire. I'll schedule a customer sync tomorrow 09:30 PT. :thumbsup:
